title: Rooftop Snipers
description: Rooftop Snipers is a chaotic two button local multiplayer game. Challenge your friends side by side or play the computer. Shoot your opponent off the map to win.
instructions: Player 1: W to shoot/jump. Player 2: up arrow to shoot/jump. Knock your opponent off the rooftop.
tags: Rooftop Snipers, 2 Player, Sniper, Shooting, Hot, Popular

title: Stickman Hook
description: Stickman Hook is a simple, original and challenging swinging game. Swing your stickman through each level using ropes and momentum.
instructions: Click and hold to swing from a rope, release to fly.
tags: Stickman, Swing, Hook, Physics, Hot, Popular

title: Soccer Random
description: Football is here with its most funny and random way! Score 5 goals to win as courts, balls, players and goalposts randomly change each round. Play vs CPU or a friend, 2 player mode.
instructions: Player 1: W to jump/kick. Player 2: Up arrow to jump/kick. Play vs CPU or a friend.
tags: Soccer, Football, Sports, 2 Player, Random, Hot, Multiplayer

title: Basket Random
description: Basketball is here with its most funny and random way! Score in either basket to win as courts, balls, and players randomly change each round. Play vs CPU or a friend, 2 player mode.
instructions: Player 1: W to jump/shoot. Player 2: Up arrow to jump/shoot.
tags: Basketball, Sports, 2 Player, Random, Hot, Multiplayer

title: Boxing Random
description: Boxing is here with its most funny and random way! Knock out your opponent as rings and boxers randomly change each round. Play vs CPU or a friend, 2 player mode.
instructions: Player 1: W to punch/jump. Player 2: Up arrow to punch/jump.
tags: Boxing, Fighting, Sports, 2 Player, Random, Hot, Multiplayer

title: Volley Random
description: Volleyball is here with its most funny and random way! Score points as courts and players randomly change each round. Play vs CPU or a friend, 2 player mode.
instructions: Player 1: W to jump/hit. Player 2: Up arrow to jump/hit.
tags: Volleyball, Sports, 2 Player, Random, Hot, Multiplayer

title: Getaway Shootout
description: Race to the extraction point by jumping! Dodge obstacles, grab weapons, and out-jump the competition in this wild multiplayer game.
instructions: Player 1: A/D to lean, W to jump. Player 2: arrow keys to lean, up to jump. Grab weapons along the way.
tags: Getaway Shootout, 2 Player, Multiplayer, Physics, Hot, Popular

title: 12 MiniBattles
description: A casual two-player game featuring various minigames with 36 uniquely chaotic mini-battles, each with simple one-button controls. Golf, wrestling, axe battle, football, duels and more.
instructions: Player 1: W. Player 2: Up arrow. Each minigame uses just one button per player.
tags: MiniBattles, 2 Player, Multiplayer, Party, Hot, Popular

title: Temple of Boom
description: A fast-paced, retro-styled platform arena shooter. Be the last one standing in the Temple of Boom, solo or against a friend.
instructions: Player 1: WASD to move, F to shoot. Player 2: arrow keys to move, M to shoot.
tags: Temple of Boom, 2 Player, Shooting, Arena, Hot, Popular

title: T-Rex Runner
description: The offline dinosaur runner, open-sourced as its own standalone game. Jump over cacti and duck under birds for as long as you can survive.
instructions: Press Space or Up to jump. Press Down to duck.
tags: T-Rex, Runner, Dinosaur, Open Source, Endless

title: Mahjong
description: The classic tile-matching puzzle. Find and clear matching pairs of tiles to empty the board.
instructions: Click two matching, unblocked tiles to remove them from the board.

title: Word Search
description: Find all the hidden words in the letter grid before time runs out.
instructions: Click and drag across letters to select a word.

title: Spider Solitaire
description: The classic 2-suit card game. Build descending sequences to clear the tableau.
instructions: Drag cards to build descending sequences. Clear a full suit run to remove it.

title: Solitaire
description: The classic Klondike card game. Sort the deck into ordered suit piles.
instructions: Drag cards to build descending, alternating-color sequences. Move aces up to start the suit piles.

title: Rolly Vortex
description: Guide the ball down the spinning tunnel, dodging colored gaps and obstacles as you descend.
instructions: Use the arrows or swipe to move the ball left/right around the tunnel.

title: Connect 4
description: The classic strategy game. Drop discs to connect four in a row before your opponent does.
instructions: Click a column to drop your disc. Connect 4 in a row (any direction) to win.

title: Merge Numbers
description: Drop and merge matching number blocks to reach higher values before the columns fill up.
instructions: Click a column to drop the current block. Matching numbers merge into one.

title: Zombie Road
description: Drive through zombie-infested roads, dodging obstacles and running down the undead.
instructions: Arrow keys or WASD to drive. Avoid crashing while taking out zombies.
